🎥🎬: Marvel Zombies (2025)

In an alternate Marvel universe, a mysterious zombie outbreak transforms some of the world’s most powerful superheroes into flesh-eating undead. As civilization collapses, the remaining heroes and survivors are forced to fight against corrupted versions of the icons they once looked up to.

The story follows a group of survivors—including Kamala Khan, Kate Bishop, Riri Williams, and others—as they search for a way to survive and protect what remains of humanity. Along the way, they encounter terrifying versions of familiar heroes, turning every battle into a fight against both the undead and their own memories.

As the survivors uncover the truth behind the outbreak, they realize that stopping the infection may require confronting the most powerful zombies on Earth. In a world where even heroes can become monsters, survival comes down to courage, sacrifice, and knowing when to fight back.
